thought: I need to implement the httpRequest action parameters to fetch 5 business news headlines from the US using NewsAPI. This requires setting method to GET, url to NewsAPI endpoint, query parameters for category, country, and pageSize, and setting the API key in headerParameters.
plan: Set url to NewsAPI top-headlines endpoint
Set query parameters: category=business, country=us, pageSize=5
Set headerParameters with API key from credentials
Test the action to ensure it fetches news
criticism: Currently, the httpRequest action has no parameters, so it cannot fetch the required news.
